messages:
Mina (People Ops): Hey team

Quick pilot idea: "Culture Cafe" micro-awards + Friday team lunch stipend. 2 simple channels: 1) Coffee tokens (Slack reaction-based spot recognitions, $10/token, up to 2 tokens/person/month). 2) Team lunch stipend ($250/month per team, request via form). Thoughts? :coffee: :sandwich:

Alex (Eng): Love the reaction flow. How do we capture who nominated? If it's a reaction, we lose author info.

Mina (People Ops): Good call. Plan: use a tiny nom form auto-populated by a slash action. Flow: react :coffee: -> bot DM prompts "Who are you nominating and why?" quick form (one-line). Keeps convo lightweight but captures nominator.

Tess (Marketing): For the lunch stipend, can cross-functional pods apply? Our content pod sometimes pairs with design.

Mina (People Ops): Yes — define "team" as any recurring pod with a shared Slack channel + 3+ people. Lina will validate org mapping.

Ravi (Legal): Any compliance or taxable implications? Small awards still count as income in some jurisdictions. Need policy note.

Mina (People Ops): Good flag. We'll treat coffee tokens <$50/yr no additional tax paperwork for US per guidelines, but we'll surface country exceptions. Any award >$600 aggregated annually will be flagged to payroll for 1099/W-2 handling. Payroll will also handle lunch stipend reporting where required.

payroll-bot: Please submit stipend requests by last Friday of the month for that month's payout. CSV export ready: requester, team, amount, GL 4-127-CULT, approved_by, ts.

Lina (Regional Ops): For APAC we need a local currency mapping. I'll create a small lookup table and local cutoffs. Also can run the pilot in NA/EU first.

Alex (Eng): How long is the pilot? Can we measure engagement?

Mina (People Ops): Pilot 3 months. Metrics: tokens redeemed, unique nominators, stipend requests, and qualitative feedback. We'll send a 2-question pulse after each month.

Tess (Marketing): I'll help with a micro-visual for the comms and a one-slide FAQ.

Ravi (Legal): Send me the FAQ draft and the form copy. I'll review any jurisdictional language.

Mina (People Ops): Will do. Next steps: 1) Lina to prepare local currency mapping by EOD Tue. 2) Tess to draft comms and faq. 3) Payroll set CSV and confirm GL. 4) Mina to set up slash-action + bot DM flow. Pilot launch planned Mon 2026-06-01. Ping me for edge cases. :sparkles:
